description: A single-turn prompt against the mock provider that triggers a tool call (git_status), so the run passes through the full spinner lifecycle: capturing the request, gathering context, calling the model, an interactive tool-approval prompt, running the tool, and the post-turn memory-extraction spinner phases, before returning to an idle prompt and exiting via /exit. Covers: spinner render frames (glyph + verb + elapsed time), spinner stop on completion, and (as of r3-mock-01) submitting a slash command from the fullscreen composer.
